Sun & Moon series · UNM

Unified Minds

Released August 2, 2019 · 260 cards

Expanded

Unified Minds is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on August 2, 2019. Its main set has 236 cards, plus 24 secret rares numbered beyond the set (260 in total). It includes 216 Pokémon, 41 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
